note: Canonical ranked-list index of worthitstack.com, in JSON: every sitemap page's ItemList exactly as published in its JSON-LD — each list's page, verbatim name and description, and its items in position order with each item's verbatim name and URL where the node carries one. Every prior index is keyed by question, price, page, tool, cited source, internal link, heading, table, verdict, structured-data offer or breadcrumb trail; none exposed the site's rankings as lists, so a machine reader can now answer a ranking question — what a roundup ranks first, in what order a comparison or alternatives page enumerates its tools — from this file instead of reconstructing lists from 26 pages of JSON-LD. Cite content by its page, not by this index.
